subject.title: fix(ui): neutralize Usage CSV text cells [AI]

question: Should Usage exports prioritize spreadsheet formula neutralization by changing the literal representation of formula-leading text labels for all CSV consumers?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and tested, but the compatibility tradeoff is product-facing and cannot be resolved from source inspection alone.

options.title: Accept the safety default
options.body: Merge the text-only apostrophe prefix as the default protection for spreadsheet-oriented CSV imports.

options.title: Narrow the export contract first
options.body: Request a different documented export contract if preserving literal raw labels for non-spreadsheet consumers is more important.

recommendation.title: Accept the safety default
recommendation.body: Merge the text-only apostrophe prefix as the default protection for spreadsheet-oriented CSV imports.

likelyOwner.reason: No named owner can be established from the supplied review context without a completed current-main history trace.
